subject: Renewal: split-invoice routing & PO for capacity increase
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@pineharbor.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Pine Harbor Labs Billing <billing@pineharbor.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal & capacity increase — invoicing and PO split

Hi Naomi,

Our renewal with Redwood is up on July 15 and we're planning to add a 40% capacity uplift across our analytics clusters. Finance wants to handle the renewal invoicing as two separate purchase orders: one billed to Pine Harbor Labs (US) and one billed to Pine Harbor Labs UK (the UK legal entity) due to different budget owners.

Can you confirm Redwood can accept split POs and invoice two payors? We'd also like to move to Net45 on the renewal (current term Net30). Please confirm any implications for proration or billing dates. I've attached a draft PO (PHL_PO_US_9012-draft.pdf) for the US side — final PO(s) coming once you confirm.

Also, please let us know what billing contact you'd like for each invoice and whether you need an updated W-9 or entity evidence for the UK payor.

Thanks,

Elena Ortiz
Head of Procurement
Pine Harbor Labs
(elena.ortiz@pineharbor.com)

Attachments: PHL_PO_US_9012-draft.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@pineharbor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase — invoicing and PO split

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up, and congrats on the expansion plans.

Short answers:
- Yes, we can accept split POs and route invoices to two separate payors.
- Moving to Net45 is acceptable; we need the PO numbers and signed amendment to lock the term change.
- We will need either a W-9 for the US payor and evidence of the UK entity (invoice remit-to) for the UK payor.

I've looped in Ben (finance lead) and Monica (contracts) to confirm routing details and to generate a DocuSign amendment for the Net45 term + capacity addendum.

Next steps:
1) Send final PO PDFs for each payor (include exact payor legal name and remit-to address).
2) Ben will confirm invoice cadence and whether proration is required for partial-month coverage.
3) We will send a DocuSign amendment — please sign to confirm Net45 + capacity add.

I'll follow up once Ben confirms the invoice schedule.

Best,
Naomi

Naomi Feldman

Elena,

We can invoice two payors. For clarity, please provide:
- Separate PO numbers for US and UK (we need unique PO per invoice)
- Legal payor name and remit-to address for each
- Billing contact and email for invoice distribution

When we receive the final POs and the signed amendment, our billing team will issue two invoices on the renewal date. If the capacity add starts mid-billing-period we'll prorate the additional capacity for the first invoice (line item will show prorated token units).

I've created a draft amendment in DocuSign for Naomi's review — link below. Once signed, Net45 will apply to future invoices on this renewal. DocuSign: https://docusign.net/signed/amendment-PHL-9012

Thanks,
